user_text: Perfect, that's done. Wow, it's really late.
text:
It is late. You've covered a huge amount of ground in this session: the full ISO 27001 project plan, SoA, P1 actions, owner assignments, risk assessment quizzes, a BIA walkthrough, a tabletop exercise kit, failover runbooks and validation commands. That's a solid foundation for the certification programme.

When you're ready to pick it up again, the next natural steps are confirming the CEO/CTO name for P1-01 and P1-04, scheduling the first risk workshop, and running a dry print of the tabletop pack. Happy to help with any of those. Get some rest.
